title: Follow-up for #1363: Move caret into a dedicated property handler
items: Replace the macro-generated fallback handling of `caret` / `caret-color` / `caret-animation` / `caret-shape` with a dedicated `CaretHandler` (like the other shorthand handlers), so it owns ordering and resets instead of the slot-clearing in prefix_handler.rs.
Merge longhands into the `caret` shorthand when the targets support it (no engine ships the shorthand yet, so this needs a compat feature and stays longhand-only for current browsers).
